1.consolidated_definition: En un documento de hacia 1570 se habla “del isleón que dicen Bieque, y del isleoncillo de poniente, a tres leguas de la costa, que dicen Pasaje”. BHPR, 1916. III, 337.
1.en_consolidated_definition: In a document dating back to around 1570, it is mentioned "of the island known as Bieque, and of the small island to the west, three leagues from the coast, known as Pasaje". BHPR, 1916. III, 337.
